review.summary: Phase 29 meets acceptance requirements. Pinned provenance, complete delta classification, unchanged SDK runtime, and source-bound passing checks are supported by inspected evidence. Earlier blocking findings are resolved. One acknowledged low-severity bookkeeping issue remains.

findings.description: Accepting a chunk leaves any prior latest_review value unchanged. The current status was corrected manually, but an in-memory reproduction confirms that rejection followed by acceptance can restore misleading bookkeeping. Acceptance verification remains effective.
findings.required_fix: Complete the scheduled phase-30 fix: clear or update latest_review on acceptance and add a rejection-then-acceptance regression.

evidence: Read AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/PHASES.md, docs/implementation-plan.md, the MCP tags plan, and phase registrations.
Independently verified fingerprint 56dbaa471fec8ba55523b1d53f643d80751df7d93a419fc79b664a6ca6caf220 before and after review.
Inspected all 19 phase-29 check commands and results: exact current command set, successful exits, no timeouts. Seven unittest suites recorded 145 cases, including one intentional skip.

Verified preserved chunk attempts 1–4 and rejected complete-phase attempt 1, including prompt, output, check-snapshot and decision bindings. Chunk attempt 4 is accepted at 9/10 for this source; the phase-attempt-2 check snapshot matches the current report exactly.

Inspected vendored provenance, YAML delta, classification ledger, extracted contract, verifier and tamper tests. Independently reran the verifier successfully: 61 classified delta items, eight imported schemas, two list operations.
Confirmed SDK and Cargo files are unchanged against 56a88d2, no untracked SDK files exist, and working-tree whitespace checks pass.
Read-only in-memory probes rejected missing, empty, renamed and duplicate chunk declarations. Reproduced the remaining bookkeeping defect with writes intercepted.
Inspected the source-matched sanitized private-material receipt and its documented limitations.
limitations: Mutation-based unit suites and the full phase gate were not rerun; their implementations and recorded results were inspected.
No network requests, credential or tenant-registration reads, edits, commits or pushes occurred. Upstream origin was not independently authenticated.
Private matching was not re-executed; the recorded gate verifies receipt freshness and structure.
Phase 30 implementation/live acceptance and phase 31 release/delivery remain future work and received no completion credit.
